result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `ScopingConventions.java`, and the new test and the existing `SourceFileFilterTest` pass offline (3 and 6 tests, no failures). Nothing is committed.

Changes in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **Generated HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now use `.*[.](htm|html|xhtml)` instead of `(html|html|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages are covered.
- **.NET XML documentation:** the rule is now `.*[.]xml` instead of `.*/[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- **JavaScript `// Generated by`:** the rule is now `.*[.]js` instead of `.*/[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle JavaScript scripts:** the rule is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js` instead of `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It checks that the intended files now match: `.htm` pages with each kind of generator marker, a `<doc>` XML file, a `// Generated by` JS file, and `build-gradle.js`. It also checks that existing matches (`.html`, `.xhtml`, the `.xhtml` meta tag case) still work, and that hand-written `.htm`, `.xml`, `.js` files and `app.js` stay out of the scopes. `build.gradle` is covered by the existing `.*[.]gradle` rule, which I did not change.
